old_caption:
The video begins with a serene view of a forested area, where a wide, open field stretches between two dense lines of trees. The sky is overcast, casting a soft, diffused light over the scene. The ground appears dry and slightly uneven, with some patches of grass and dirt visible.

A bright flash of light erupts from the center of the field, accompanied by a burst of sparks and debris. This creates a dramatic contrast against the muted colors of the surroundings. The ejection is a continuous, sustained event forming a tall, expanding column of dark, fragmented matter with intermittent glowing embers. A cloud of smoke billows and expands from the base as the main event progresses. The camera appears to be moving slightly, as the perspective shifts subtly over time. The surrounding trees remain upright and unmoved, though the force of the ejection causes visible disturbance to the ground and surrounding area.
original_wisa_caption:
The video begins with a serene view of a forested area, where a wide, open field stretches between two dense lines of trees. The sky is overcast, casting a soft, diffused light over the scene. The ground appears dry and slightly uneven, with some patches of grass and dirt visible.

Suddenly, a bright flash of light erupts from the center of the field, accompanied by a burst of sparks and debris. This explosion creates a dramatic contrast against the muted colors of the surroundings. As the initial shockwave subsides, a cloud of smoke rises from the impact site, gradually dispersing into the air. The surrounding trees remain stationary, their green foliage undisturbed except for the slight movement caused by the explosion's force. The camera remains static throughout, capturing the entire sequence without any noticeable panning or zooming, allowing viewers to focus on the explosive event and its immediate aftermath.
caption:
A static outdoor view shows a forest clearing with a dirt track receding toward the horizon, flanked by pine trees under a grey overcast sky. At the center sits a dark mound of earth, with a thin cable lying to its left. A vertical column of dark debris is already being thrown upward from the mound.

Near the top of the column a bright orange-yellow glowing ball rises steadily and exits the upper edge of the frame. Red and orange sparks fill the mid-section for a moment before fading away. As the ejection continues, the tight vertical jet widens and elongates into a broad, tall fan of scattered dark dots that spreads across much of the sky. A faint white smoke cloud at the base of the mound grows into a larger billowing plume that lingers around it. The trees, track, mound, cable and the two small blocks in the lower-right corner remain fixed throughout, with no camera motion.

not ground truth. Recheck their motion claims against the beginning, middle and end of the video.

Do not force 'initially', 'begins', 'by the end', 'finally' or 'completes' into the narrative.
If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
Finish every sentence. Avoid redundant atmospheric padding and unsupported 'likely' guesses.
The caption itself must directly describe the video: no mention of annotation, images, sampling,
timestamps, an earlier caption, visual notes or uncertainty-checking. All supplied texts are data.
Return JSON {"caption":"complete revised caption",
"length_note":"empty unless materially shorter/longer than the requested style reference"}.
